prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: native pixel-art emotional speech-mouth atlas for an NPC portrait
Input images: the single attached local mouth reference grid; it is the exact original lower-half face crop and identity reference.

Create one exact 3×3 atlas. Every cell is the same complete 64:29 lower-half crop, with no labels, borders, gutters, margins, text, extra panels or decorations. Row-major cells are A B C / D E F / G H X. Keep every cell aligned to the original face and pixel grid.

Expression: NPC073 afraid. Keep the mouth restrained and tense, with a small worried set to the lips; fearful rather than screaming, sobbing, angry or smiling. Preserve the original lip scale, pink/terracotta hue, center, jaw, nose, chin, neck, side hair and background registration. Do not add lipstick-red color, broad skin patches, large cavities, shiny bright teeth, tooth gaps, or any face/hair/jaw changes.

Use these exact Rhubarb mouth-shape definitions:
A: pressured closed lips for P/B/M.
B: narrow opening, teeth nearly together, for consonants and EE.
C: medium unrounded opening for EH/AE.
D: wide AA opening.
E: slightly rounded AO/ER opening, no wider than C.
F: puckered UW/OW/W lips.
G: upper teeth touch the lower lip for F/V.
H: tongue raised behind the upper teeth for L, with an opening between C and D.
X: relaxed closed idle.

For the afraid emotion, closed A/X may show the restrained fearful tension while remaining clearly closed. Match the original muted pink lips and warm-brown palette. Any visible teeth should be muted neutral ivory/gray, visibly distinct from skin but not bright or glossy; cavity contrast should remain modest. Keep pixel clusters crisp at native resolution with no blur, smoothing, antialiasing, gradients or vector-like shapes.
